15. 圖中，四邊形 $ABCD$ 的面積為
A. $144 \text{ cm}^2$ 。
B. $160 \text{ cm}^2$ 。
C. $178 \text{ cm}^2$ 。
D. $288 \text{ cm}^2$ 。
reasoning: First, calculate the length of $AC$ in the right-angled triangle $ADC$ using Pythagoras' theorem: $AC^2 = 6^2 + 8^2 = 100$, so $AC = 10\text{ cm}$. The area of $\triangle ADC = \frac{1}{2} \times 6 \times 8 = 24\text{ cm}^2$. Then, calculate the length of $AB$ in the right-angled triangle $ABC$: $AB^2 = 26^2 - 10^2 = 676 - 100 = 576$, so $AB = 24\text{ cm}$. The area of $\triangle ABC = \frac{1}{2} \times 24 \times 10 = 120\text{ cm}^2$. The total area of quadrilateral $ABCD$ is the sum of the areas of the two triangles: $24 + 120 = 144\text{ cm}^2$.
